description: Compare all covered registrars for one extension. Returns source failures, quote timestamps and minimum terms; availability is not checked.

direction.description: Ascending or descending result order. Unknown totals follow priced totals in either price direction.

favorites.description: Up to two distinct connected registrar IDs, comma-separated. Adds saved favorite offers and fresh baselines for this result page, independent of filters. Does not save preferences or check names.

format.description: Response representation. CSV and Markdown use the same filters, order and bounded pagination; they contain main offers, not favorite comparison arrays. MCP retains structured JSON alongside rendered text.

includeStale.description: Accepted for compatibility. Saved prices stay in results until a successful refresh replaces them and are labeled stale. includeStale=true still requires view=all.

limit.description: Maximum number of results, up to 200.

name.description: One ASCII domain label without the extension, such as myproject. Price and link tools only build links from it; availability and popularity tools send the exact domain to their providers.

offset.description: Result offset. Follow pagination.next for additional results; the feed can change between requests.

orderBy.description: Order results by the selected price metric or extension. Cheapest-per-extension winners are selected before ordering.

registrar.description: Connected registrar ID from the registrars endpoint. Omit to compare all.

registrars.description: Comma-separated connected registrar IDs to compare together. Use instead of registrar. Cheapest-per-extension winners are chosen within this set.

sort.description: Ranking metric. Total uses a conservative new-registration estimate.

tld.description: One covered ASCII top-level extension, such as com or .com. Multi-part suffixes and IDNs are not covered.

years.description: Planning horizon in years, including initial registration.

name: get_tld_prices
title: Compare prices for an extension
